name: query-profiles
title: Guide: Query Profiles
description: Agent-facing guide for canonical buyer query patterns and when to use them.
text:
# Query Profiles

TL;DR:
- Prefer a canonical query profile over improvised filter composition when the user intent is clear.
- Profiles reduce model improvisation and make recovery easier when a query returns nothing.
- Use zbav://mcp/profile/* resources for concrete request patterns.

What profiles are for:
- Query profiles describe intent-safe request shapes for common buyer search workflows.
- They show which filter fields are required, which fields are optional, and what to avoid.
- They are not hard API constraints. They are canonical patterns for reliable agent behavior.

Available buyer profiles:
- zbav://mcp/profile/buyer.search.byDelivery
- zbav://mcp/profile/buyer.search.nearby
- zbav://mcp/profile/buyer.search.mine
- zbav://mcp/profile/buyer.search.byCategory
- zbav://mcp/profile/buyer.search.favourites

Agent rule:
- If the user intent clearly matches one of these profiles, start from the profile instead of composing an ad-hoc query from scratch.
- If no profile fits exactly, choose the nearest profile and then add one or two extra constraints instead of inventing a completely new query strategy.
